description: Turn the public link of a dashboard on, reissue it or turn it off. Anyone with the public link sees the dashboard charts without login (read only, they can change only the period); it works until it is turned off. enable keeps the current link if it is already on, reissue makes a new link and the old one stops working at once, disable turns it off. Needs the owner or editor role in the org

action.description: enable, reissue or disable the public link

name: analytics_dashboard_share_link
